tamarind.note: Tamarind Bio remote MCP server. The host obtains its own OAuth client identity and runs the browser authorization flow on first connection. Keep this entry to type/url/note only: pinning oauth.client_id preempts the host's own registration, and pinning oauth_resource makes the host send the RFC 8707 resource parameter twice, which Clerk rejects as a duplicate. Scientific submissions can consume weighted compute hours.
